info.title: AXLR Bots operator API
info.description: The routes the operator address serves (axlr-bots serve --api-listen), behind the bearer token. The prose reference is operator-api.md. adapters/unixapi/contract_test.go checks this file against the server; panel/tests/operator_contract.rs checks that the panel reads every answer it describes.
